issues: 框内面板全是灰色骨架条，下半截约 1/3 是空白
悬空组件的"同形软影"是内容的灰色模糊副本，而且越高越深，读作脏糊块而不是投影
落定 scale 1.04 + 透视，面板右上角顶出画框
没有导出时长，工作台按默认 150f 渲染，尾段约 0.7s 死帧
面板与背景管群之间没有深度分隔，暗场大面积平涂
changes: 面板换成出版级工作台首页：品牌 + 导航（带未读 badge）+ Spaces 色标、问候标题 + 搜索框（⌘K）+ 7 张最近卡 + 页签 + 6 行任务（优先级圈 / 状态 chip / 头像 / 截止日）；面板高 900→790 去掉空白
软影改为纯剪影（brightness(0)）：离地越高越大越虚越淡（不透明度 0.3→0.08），贴近时收小变实；悬空本体按高度微放大；页面不再裁切，悬空组件可探出面板边缘
落定 scale 改 0.92（起始 0.86），整框连辉光留在画内；面板补深色落地影把它从管群里托出来
补导出 NEON_FRAME_FORERUN_DURATION=135（md 的 4–4.5s 内），框奔画 / 点亮 / 错峰贴落 / 背景中亮尾熄时间轴全部保留
背景霓虹管减细到 1.6px，加暗角与颗粒
issuesEn: The panel inside the frame was all grey skeleton bars with roughly the bottom third empty
The "matching soft shadow" under floating parts was a blurred grey copy of the content that got darker the higher it floated, reading as smudges rather than shadows
The final scale of 1.04 plus perspective pushed the panel's top-right corner out of frame
No duration export, so the workbench rendered the default 150f with about 0.7s of dead tail
No depth separation between panel and background tubes; the dark field was flat
changesEn: The panel is now a publication-grade workspace home: brand, nav with unread badge, colored Spaces, greeting title, ⌘K search, seven recent cards, tabs and six task rows (priority ring, status chip, avatars, due date); panel height 900→790 removes the void

Shadows are pure silhouettes (brightness(0)) that grow larger, softer and fainter with height (opacity 0.3→0.08) and tighten on contact; floating parts scale slightly with height, and the page no longer clips so lifted parts can overhang the panel edge
Final scale is 0.92 (from 0.86) so the whole frame and glow stay in shot; a deep drop shadow lifts the panel off the tube field
Added NEON_FRAME_FORERUN_DURATION=135 (within the md's 4–4.5s); trace, light-up, staggered landing and center-first background fade timings are unchanged
Background tubes thinned to 1.6px, plus vignette and grain
